scheme_name: National Award For Senior Citizens (vayoshreshtha Samman): Courage & Bravery
description:
The National Award for Senior Citizens is also known as Vayoshreshtha Samman. 

This award was instituted by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India. 

The scheme was launched in the year 2005. 

The primary aim of this award is to recognize the contributions of senior citizens in various fields. 

The award seeks to honor those individuals who have made significant contributions to society. 

The awards are given in various categories including courage and bravery. 

The specific category of Courage and Bravery recognizes senior citizens who have shown exceptional bravery in the face of adversity. 

The award is intended to encourage and motivate senior citizens to continue contributing positively to society. 

The objectives of the Vayoshreshtha Samman include promoting awareness about the contributions of senior citizens. 

The scheme aims to create a positive image of aging in society. 

It also seeks to encourage active participation of senior citizens in nation-building activities. 

The awards are presented annually on the International Day of Older Persons, which is celebrated on October 1. 

The awardees receive a certificate of appreciation and a cash prize. 

The cash prize for the award is ₹100,000. 

The award also includes a citation recognizing the achievements of the recipient. 

Eligibility for the Vayoshreshtha Samman is primarily based on age. 

Applicants must be senior citizens aged 60 years or above. 

The award is open to all Indian citizens. 

There are no specific educational qualifications required for the applicants. 

However, the contributions made by the applicants must be noteworthy and impactful. 

The application process for the award involves several steps. 

Interested candidates must submit their nominations through the online portal provided by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. 

Nominations can also be submitted through recognized organizations working for the welfare of senior citizens. 

The required documents for the application include a detailed bio-data of the nominee. 

Nominations must include a description of the contributions made by the nominee. 

Supporting documents that validate the contributions should also be attached. 

The nomination must be submitted along with a recommendation from a recognized organization. 

The deadline for submitting nominations is usually set a few months prior to the International Day of Older Persons. 

The exact date for the submission of nominations is announced annually. 

Once the nominations are received, they are reviewed by a selection committee. 

The selection committee comprises experts in the field of gerontology and social work. 

The committee evaluates the contributions based on predefined criteria. 

The awardees are then selected and announced publicly. 

The awards are presented in a formal ceremony attended by dignitaries and officials from the government. 

The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment is the implementing authority for this scheme. 

The ministry is responsible for the overall coordination and management of the award process. 

For any inquiries related to the Vayoshreshtha Samman, individuals can contact the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. 

The contact details for the ministry can be found on their official website. 

The scheme aims to highlight the importance of senior citizens in society. 

It also seeks to address the issues faced by the elderly population. 

The Vayoshreshtha Samman serves as a platform to showcase the achievements of senior citizens. 

It encourages a culture of respect and recognition for the elderly. 

The award has gained significant recognition over the years. 

It has inspired many senior citizens to engage in community service and social work. 

The initiative aligns with the broader goals of the Government of India to empower the elderly. 

The government has been actively working on various policies and programs for senior citizens. 

The Vayoshreshtha Samman is one of the key initiatives in this regard. 

The award not only recognizes individual contributions but also promotes a sense of community among senior citizens. 

It fosters collaboration among various stakeholders including NGOs and government bodies. 

The award has also been instrumental in raising awareness about the rights and needs of senior citizens. 

It encourages society to value the wisdom and experience of older individuals. 

The Vayoshreshtha Samman is a testament to the government's commitment to the welfare of senior citizens. 

The scheme has evolved over the years to adapt to the changing needs of the elderly population. 

The award is a significant step towards creating an inclusive society. 

It emphasizes the importance of recognizing and celebrating the achievements of senior citizens. 

The Vayoshreshtha Samman continues to inspire and motivate individuals to contribute positively to society. 

The scheme plays a crucial role in enhancing the quality of life for senior citizens in India. 

It highlights the importance of intergenerational solidarity and respect. 

The award serves as a reminder of the invaluable contributions made by senior citizens. 

The Vayoshreshtha Samman is an important initiative that reflects the values of compassion and respect for the elderly. 

Through this award, the government aims to create a supportive environment for senior citizens. 

The recognition provided by the Vayoshreshtha Samman encourages senior citizens to remain active and engaged. 

It is a celebration of life and the contributions that come with age. 

The award not only honors individuals but also serves as a model for society to emulate. 

The Vayoshreshtha Samman is a significant initiative in promoting the welfare of senior citizens in India.
